title: Hi3DGen is seriously the SOTA image-to-3D mesh model right now
author: fisj

comments.author: FizKult
comments.body:
In the middle of last month, a user with the nickname Linder Germain published 36,000 low poly models in FAB (Epic Games)!

The problem is that these were models for mobile games and each of them contained 500K triangles on average. Visually, they looked good, but you can see for yourself that such a thing is not suitable for mobile games at all.

After about a week, all of his content was deleted. [Update on products generated with AI - General / Announcements - Epic Developer Community Forums](https://forums.unrealengine.com/t/update-on-products-generated-with-ai/2523501)

3D model generators are really interesting, but you should think a lot before using such models.

replies.author: Itchy_Mycologist_513
replies.body: That is a good point. Is there post processing software one can use to reduce the poly count after creating a high quality model like this?

replies.author: FizKult
replies.body: Hi. To be honest, I do not know. I've never been interested in this issue. Most likely, you just need to go to the sections where people study 3D modeling. For example, Blender 3D.

replies.author: smoke2000
replies.body: yes there is , many of them , decimation master in zbrush for example, can reduce the polys considerably but it still leaves a bad mesh. It has automatic remeshers as well that try to make a clean mesh that can be textured and animated. None of that is really an issue, it exists for a long time.
